Curated parallels on SuttaCentral align its verses with other Pali canonical passages, notably in the Jātaka (Ja 320 *Succajajātaka*, Ja 363 *Hirijātaka*, and Ja 380 *Āsaṅkajātaka*), the *Saṁyutta Nikāya* (SN 1.35 *Ujjhānasaññisutta*), and other *Theragāthā* verses (Thag 3.3 *Bākulattheragāthā* and Thag 3.15 *Hāritattheragāthā*) [SuttaCentral]. It also shares verses with the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 51–52) and its diverse non-Pali recensions, including the Gāndhārī Dharmapada (G-Dhp 290–304, G3-Dhp 61–73), the Patna Dharmapada (P-Dhp 121–136), the Sanskrit and Tibetan Udānavarga traditions (UV 18, UVS 18, Uv Kg 18), and early Chinese translations (T 210.12, T 212.19, and T 213.18) [SuttaCentral].
